result.reason: The redline substantially tracks the preferred position: Client may assign to a transaction successor without consent, TrueLink assignments require consent subject to a reasonableness standard, assignments to Client competitors are prohibited, and no change-of-control termination right is added. However, Client’s affiliate carve-out remains limited to a “financially responsible affiliate,” whereas the preferred position permits assignment to any affiliate without consent. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, though the margin comment overstates the unrestricted nature of the affiliate right.
